summary: Iteration 11: full backend + frontend verification for USDT四方 enhancements (richer order detail, chain-tx records, merchant daily stats, security hardening). 26/26 pytest cases pass including rate-limit trip. Frontend: Dashboard today cards (stat-today-orders=81, stat-today-paid=21, stat-today-success=25.9%) all render for admin/merchant/agent; /orders detail dialog shows all required fields (订单号/商户/通道/网络/收款地址/TxID/商户单号/回调地址/回调状态/手续费/实收/创建/支付/过期/收款模式) with external explorer anchors; admin sees view-chain-txs-btn and chain-tx-dialog correctly lists chain txs for that wallet (TU4vEruvZwLLkSfV9bNw12EJTPvNr7Pvaa shown with explorer tronscan link); merchant does NOT see the button (confirmed False). /addresses has chaintx-btn-<address> on 3 rows, dialog opens. /security SecurityPolicyCard renders with policy-enforce_admin_2fa / policy-enforce_operator_2fa / policy-login_alert checkboxes + policy-save-btn (enabled for admin). Backend: GET /api/chain/txs admin-only — merchant/agent/operator all 403 (operator lacks channels.manage as expected). GET /api/security/policy allowed for admin & operator; PUT allowed only for admin (merchant/operator 403). Security headers (X-Frame-Options=DENY, X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, Permissions-Policy) present on both authed and 401 responses. Rate limit tripped on request #~301 to /api/auth/me with detail '请求过于频繁，请稍后再试'. Login new-device email is fire-and-forget — merchant login returned 200 + token in <5s. Policy reset to defaults (all False, login_alert True) and admin ajin53193@gmail.com confirmed with 2FA DISABLED at end.

critical_code_review_comments: /api/chain/txs uses require_roles('admin') — review request wording was 'admin/operator (with channels.manage)' but implementation is admin-only. Confirmed with context note this is intentional/expected because operator lacks channels.manage. If main agent later wants operator-with-perm access, switch to a permission-based dependency (e.g. require_perm('channels.manage')).

security_middleware rate-limit bucket is in-memory dict — fine for single-pod preview, but will be ineffective across replicas in prod. Consider Redis-backed limiter for production (slowapi + aioredis).
security_middleware cleanup check `if len(_rl_bucket) > 5000` happens inside the hot path per request — move to periodic background task to avoid O(n) scans in request handler.
login_ips list grows unbounded if ever changed to not slice; current `(known + [ip])[-10:]` is good — keep.
No DialogDescription in several shadcn Dialogs; triggers Radix a11y warnings observed in console (OrderDetailDialog, ChainTxDialog).
